summary_en: Avantia executed an off-auction self-share purchase of 300,000 shares (2.06% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) at 828 yen per share on October 14, 2026, for a total of 248.4 million yen via ToSTNeT-3.
title_en: Notice Regarding Self-Share Purchase through Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 13, 2026, Avantia's board of directors authorized a specific execution of an off-auction self-share purchase under the Companies Act. On October 14, 2026, the company placed an order for an off-auction purchase (ToSTNeT-3) at the closing price of 828 yen per share.

The execution resulted in the purchase of 300,000 shares, representing 2.06% of shares outstanding (calculated as 300,000 divided by 14,563,589 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock). The total acquisition cost was 248.4 million yen. The purchase order was limited to the specific trading session and was not extended to other trading systems or times.

This execution is part of a broader share buyback authorization approved by the board, which permits acquisitions of up to 350,000 shares (2.41% of shares outstanding) for up to 300 million yen through off-auction purchases and other market purchases during the period from October 14, 2026 through January 29, 2027.
